title: Smoked Haddock Tacos
description: A twist on traditional Mexican tacos with smoked haddock, onions, and hash browns. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add hash browns and cook until golden brown, stirring occasionally.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add smoked haddock and cook until warmed through.
Warm tortillas by wrapping in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing a portion of the smoked haddock mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of queso fresco, a dollop of salsa, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Optional: Top with a squeeze of lime juice and a sprinkle of cilantro.
